title.value: Predicting Infectiousness for Proactive Contact Tracing
title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on predicting infectiousness using proactive contact tracing methods.
title.quote: P REDICTING I NFECTIOUSNESS FOR P ROACTIVE C ONTACT T RACING

analysis.description: This research paper presents a proactive contact tracing (PCT) method using deep learning to predict COVID-19 infectiousness based on contact history and other relevant information. It aims to provide personalized recommendations to individuals while ensuring strong privacy constraints. By utilizing features from smartphones, the method improves accuracy over traditional binary contact tracing methods, potentially reducing disease spread with lower mobility restrictions.
